name: io.github.markolis-quant/markolis
description: Empirical market telemetry, 100-bin AMT, trapped crowd, Yang-Zhang vol & macro shock radar.

tools.name: render_market_intelligence_frame
tools.description: Queries the isolated read-only market intelligence snapshot for any FX, metal, commodity, crypto, or index instrument and returns both a regulatory-compliant analysis and an interactive MCP App visualization frame (order book trapped crowd histogram, macro causal transmission graph with breaking shocks & sovereign spreads, and Yang-Zhang jump-volatility / regime entropy sparkline).

query.description: Natural language market intelligence query (e.g., 'Where are retail traders trapped on Gold?')

default_symbol.description: Instrument code if not explicitly named in query (e.g., 'XAU_USD', 'EUR_USD', 'USD_JPY')

use_llm.description: Whether to use LLM synthesis (default true) or deterministic institutional summary

format.description: Output payload format: 'full' includes LLM narrative markdown and ui:// interactive resource (1.0 CU); 'json_compact' returns raw deterministic JSON telemetry (0.1 CU).

tools.name: get_market_telemetry
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive empirical quantitative telemetry for an asset (regime entropy, Hurst persistence, Yang-Zhang open-jump volatility, jump variation ratio, jump-adjusted conformal cones, order book positioning, CFTC COT, sovereign intermarket yields/VIX/MOVE, breaking news shocks, and macro catalysts).

format.description: Output format: 'full' returns detailed telemetry structure (1.0 CU); 'json_compact' returns lightweight structured JSON for automated pipelines (0.1 CU).

tools.name: get_macro_radar
tools.description: Retrieves real-time global macroeconomic radar across 9 empirical feeds — Free: session clock, live Forex Factory Tier-1 calendar blackouts, DefiLlama 24h/7d stablecoin velocity, Polymarket/Kalshi odds + 24h deltas, Breaking News Shock Radar; Pro: GDELT 2.0 tone, FRED credit/real yields/net Fed liquidity, CFTC COT institutional positioning, and Sovereign Intermarket (ECB/BoE/MoF 10Y spreads, DXY, VIX/MOVE volatility surface).

symbol.description: Optional instrument ticker (e.g. 'EUR_USD', 'XAU_USD') to attach symbol-specific COT positioning, currency-matched calendar events, and active breaking shocks.

tools.name: get_prop_guardian_status
tools.description: Returns live systematic risk telemetry for prop challenge pacing: trailing drawdown kill-switch headroom, daily loss usage, Bayesian Kelly allocation sizing, and live macro news-blackout / breaking-shock guardrails.

daily_loss_limit_pct.description: Prop firm maximum daily loss limit percentage (e.g. 5.0 for 5%).

stop_loss_pips.description: Planned stop loss distance in pips for dynamic position sizing.

firm_preset.description: Firm risk model preset: 'FTMO' (Static Daily), 'Topstep' (EOD Trailing), 'Apex' (Intraday Peak Trailing), or 'Custom'.

tools.name: get_verified_catalog
tools.description: Returns Markolis's 30-stream verified product catalog across all 5 commercial tiers.
